title: Massive CME event during the Older Dryas

tellings.quote: massive CME event unlike anything that we've ever seen in modern human history hit the earth

plain: Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient history, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2024 that about 14,500 years ago, during a cold spell called the Older Dryas near the end of the last ice age, a massive blast of charged gas from the Sun hit the Earth. He says it was unlike anything seen in modern human history and points to Antarctic ice cores, long tubes of ancient ice, as his evidence. If true, it would mean the Sun once struck our planet with devastating force.
